milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the iron trapdoor and face it, demonstrating they have visually located it. The iron trapdoor is placed at spawn-relative [4, 0, 1]. max_distance=3.0 ensures the player must walk at least ~1.1 blocks from spawn (since spawn-to-target distance is ~4.12 blocks). facing_tolerance=60° confirms the player is looking toward the trapdoor.
